note: The voiceover: Sam's inner monologue. 'say' is read by the voice ('Custom Domain' as two words). 'gap' is the silence after the line. scripts/vo_build.py places the lines and writes their starts into timeline.json.

lines.say: Two thirteen in the morning. Another domain ticket.
Maya. She added her records three days ago, and she launches tomorrow.
She typed her whole domain into the name field. Of course she did. Nobody ever tells you how this works.
Every week, the same questions. Where are my DNS settings? Which records? Why does it still say pending?
None of it is about our product. All of it lands on us.
Now, customers like Maya sign in to their DNS provider, right inside our app, and approve.
The records are written for them, checked, and kept that way.
Her next domain went live while she was still on the page.
And at two thirteen in the morning, I'm asleep.
Custom Domain. You never touch their DNS. Neither does your support team.
